description: The Identity/set update handler only guards against 'email' (immutable). It does not reject patches that include 'id' (immutable+server-set) or 'mayDelete' (server-set). A client patch containing {mayDelete: false} is silently forwarded to backend.update_object. A backend that applies JSON Merge Patch naively will accept this, permanently preventing deletion of an identity the server intended to be deletable. The spec marks id as immutable+server-set and mayDelete as server-set — both should be rejected in the handler layer the same way email is. Precedent: Email/set already rejects all immutable fields via find_immutable_patch_key.
title: Identity/set update does not guard server-set mayDelete field
